{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_dist,
       y.avg_total_amount AS avg_amount,
       d.d_day_name
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
WHERE d.d_dow = 4

ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],"note":"Baseline Thursdays in November 2024; d_dow=4 maps to Thursday (1=Sunday per Zetaris docs)."}

{
  "sql": "WITH thursdays AS (
  SELECT trip_date, trips
  FROM whybot.yellow_daily
  WHERE d_dow = 4
    AND trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
),
weather AS (
  SELECT obs_date, prcp_mm
  FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily
),
holidays AS (
  SELECT holiday_date
  FROM whybot.us_holidays
  WHERE is_national = true
)
SELECT t.trip_date,
       t.trips,
       w.prcp_mm,
       CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'federal_holiday' ELSE 'non_holiday' END AS holiday_status
FROM thursdays t
LEFT JOIN weather w ON w.obs_date = t.trip_date
LEFT JOIN holidays h ON h.holiday_date = t.trip_date
WHERE w.prcp_mm > 20
  AND h.holiday_date IS NULL
ORDER BY t.trip_date
LIMIT 50",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.nyc_weather_daily", "whybot.us_holidays", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim"],
  "note": "Filters to Thursdays (d_dow=4) with heavy rain (>20mm) that are not federal holidays, returning trip counts and weather data for comparison against the Thursday baseline."
}

Joins weather and holidays on trip_date. LIMIT 50 keeps output under 200 rows."}

{
  "sql": "WITH weekly_thurs AS (
  SELECT y.trip_date,
         y.trips,
         d.d_day_name,
         h.holiday_name,
         h.is_national
  FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
  JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date
  LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date
  WHERE d.d_dow = 4
    AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
),
thurs_stats AS (
  SELECT trip_date,
         trips,
         d_day_name,
         holiday_name,
         is_national,
         AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) OVER (PARTITION BY NULL) AS baseline_avg_thurs
  FROM weekly_thurs
)
SELECT trip_date,
       trips,
       d_day_name,
       holiday_name,
       is_national,
       CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips
            ELSE NULL END AS target_trips,
       CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN baseline_avg_thurs
            ELSE NULL END AS baseline_avg_thurs
FROM thurs_stats
ORDER BY trip_date
",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "TPCDS_DB.date_dim", "whybot.us_holidays"],
  "note": "Uses conditional aggregation (MAX/CASE pattern avoided per Zetaris quirk 1) to compute baseline average across all federal-holiday Thursdays except Thanksgiving, then flags the target date. LEFT JOIN ensures days without a holiday still appear."
}
